name: runway-monorepo
description: Runway: a real-time dashboard for CSE students that connects GitHub, Codeforces, a resume and a timetable, with an AI agent that plans and sorts.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
